annotations.title: Trucking carrier vetting (FMCSA USDOT / MC lookup)

description: Trucking carrier vetting (FMCSA USDOT / MC lookup) — Vet a U.S. motor carrier before tendering a load, from the FMCSA Company Census (U.S. DOT open data): legal and DBA name, USDOT status, interstate/intrastate operation, for-hire vs private classification, MC/FF/MX dockets, years registered, fleet (power units, drivers, CDL drivers, hazmat), cargo types, safety rating and MCS-150 update date, with flags (inactive, unsatisfactory/conditional rating, stale MCS-150, new registration, no power units, no operating docket) and a verdict OK / REVIEW / AVOID. Params: one of dot (USDOT number), mc (docket like MC-135797) or name (company name; returns a match list when ambiguous). Does not show live authority or insurance status. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_carrier_vet
